annotations.text:
Redesign scope: sign-in, coach panel, player, match history, pro drafts.

The draft room is deliberately NOT here — it stays exactly as it is.

All copy is English. Colors are team-neutral; the logo slot is a placeholder mark until the Pyramid IV logo arrives.
Accent color is a lever: use the color chip above any board to try the four options. The default is the violet. Win/loss and blue/red side colors never change — they carry meaning.
Numbers are real where the app has them today (ranks, LP, win rates, series scores, champion pools). Bans, weekly game counts and game timings are sample values.
